description: Assert instead of look. Waits for the program to settle, checks the expectations and returns only {pass, failures}. A failure carries the reason and the closest things that do exist (nearest rectangles by colour, nearby text, the actual sim value), and the session saves PNGs plus a JSON dump to disk (`evidence`) that you open only if the text is not enough. Costs a few lines; prefer it over craftos_ui when you know what you expect.

items.description: One check; give exactly one of rect, text, waiting, sim or changed.

changed.description: Whether any screen differs from the last view.

rect.description: Elements on screen (default: at least one).

path.description: Dotted path into the sim state, e.g. "inventories.chest_0".

waiting.description: What the program is blocked on.

waitMs.description: Keep re-checking for this long before failing: games animate with timers, so a screen can be still between frames.

name: craftos_expect
